The complete yasya smṛtyā ca verse and nāmatraya mantra are not printed; only reference words are given. The current guide has a full yasya smṛtyā ca prayer in puja section 66.

key_difference: PDF page 14, numbered passage 24 prints uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate (Ṛgveda 1.40.1). That verse is absent from all current guide sections. Current guide section 72 (visarjana) instead has uttiṣṭha devi kalyāṇi and the Sarasvatī dismissal prayer.
